newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FENCING-FRENCH MEN TAKE FOIL GOLD IN THRILLER.
newsitem.headline: FENCING-FRENCH MEN TAKE FOIL GOLD IN THRILLER.

text.p: France won their second gold medal of the world fencing championships on Friday to halt Cuba's golden run.
The French trio of Patrice L'Hotellier, Lionel Plumenail and Franck Boidin overcame Cuba's foil team 45-43 in a gripping final in which the lead changed hands three times.
L'Hotellier was France's hero, twice tilting the final back to his side with 7-1 and 7-2 victories when his side trailed 15-13 and 35-33.
It was France's second gold after Erick Srecki's success in the men's epee on Tuesday.
Italy won their second gold -- to add to a silver and three bronzes -- with a fine performance from their women's foil team who recorded an ultimately comfortable 45-36 victory over Romania.
Individual foil gold medallist Giovanna Trillini claimed her second title with a bout-turning 8-0 victory over Reka Szabo-Lazar to give Italy a decisive 35-28 lead.
